tools.name: search_medical
tools.description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over Arca's mirrored public-source corpus: FDA drug labels, Drugs@FDA approvals, complete response letters, warning letters, Orange Book, Purple Book, NDC, drug shortages, device 510(k)/PMA/registrations, MAUDE adverse events, DailyMed, GUDID, postmarket requirements

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Ranked PubMed literature search: Arca's paper index fused with PubMed Best Match, with citation and open-access metadata from OpenAlex. Returns papers with title, authors, journal, year, DOI, PMID, abstract, citation count, and open-access status.

tools.name: fetch_source_record
tools.description: Read the full indexed text of one record from the public-source corpus by its recordId (returned by search_medical). Use after search when the excerpt is not enough.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Describe the corpus this server searches: the source lanes search_medical accepts in sourceTypes, with the underlying mirrored datasets in each.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_medical · Private data: search_medical, fetch_source_record · Public sink: search_medical.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_medical · Private data: search_medical, fetch_source_record · Public sink: search_medical

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
